name: Proposal for a decision
title: REPORT on the request for the waiver of the immunity of Ilaria Salis
part_text:
The European Parliament has decided not to lift the legal protection (immunity) of Ilaria Salis, a Member of the European Parliament elected in Italy. Hungary's Budapest Regional Court asked for this protection to be removed so it could continue criminal proceedings against her over alleged violent attacks in Budapest in February 2023. Parliament concluded the case looks like an attempt to silence her political activism, so it refused the request.

- **What changes:** Nothing in the law. Parliament refuses to lift Salis's immunity, so Hungary cannot proceed against her for now.
- **Who it affects:** Ilaria Salis and the Budapest Regional Court in Hungary.
- **What happens next:** Parliament's President sends the decision to the Hungarian court and to Salis.
